extracted.name: Grands! Easy Taco Melts
extracted.description: Circles of refrigerated biscuit dough are wrapped around a taco filling to make these easy empanadas. Simply bake and serve with salsa.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound (at least 80%) ground beef, cooked, drained
1.5 cups Old El Paso® Thick 'n Chunky Salsa
1 (16.3 ounce) can Pillsbury® Grands!® refrigerated biscuits
0.5 cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese or Mexican cheese blend
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Grease a cookie sheet.
In a nonstick skillet, mix cooked beef and 1/2 cup salsa. Cook over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally, until hot.

Press each biscuit into a 6-inch round. Spoon 1/3 cup meat mixture and 1 tablespoon cheese onto the center of each round. Fold dough in half over filling; press to seal. Place on prepared cookie sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, 9 to 14 minutes. Serve with remaining salsa.
